explanation: Searched Mathlib/RingTheory/PowerSeries and Mathlib/RingTheory/MvPowerSeries for C_dvd, dvd_coeff, map_C_iff, ker_map, map_eq_zero and Ideal.map C. Also searched all of Mathlib outside the polynomial folders for C_dvd, dvd_C_ and map_C_iff, and read the Weierstrass preparation file. The exact analogue exists only for multivariate polynomials (MvPolynomial.C_dvd_iff_map_hom_eq_zero, MvPolynomial.C_dvd_iff_dvd_coeff), and Ideal.mem_map_C_iff exists for polynomials. I found no PowerSeries or MvPowerSeries version saying that a series whose image in the residue field is zero is divisible by C ϖ, nor a coefficientwise C-divisibility criterion. The only related lemmas, PowerSeries.X_dvd_iff and PowerSeries.X_pow_dvd_iff, concern divisibility by X. The library's proof works coefficient by coefficient with general lemmas only.
